s1.f2: A co-educational secondary school for boys and girls from JSS1 to SSS3, founded in September 2005 in Elimgbu, Port Harcourt.

s2.f3: A serene place to learn, and to grow.
s2.f4: Welcome to JECK Comprehensive College. Since 2005 our aim has been simple: to raise a total child, sound in spirit, in character, in body and in mind. Here every student is known by name, encouraged to aim higher and supported by graduate teachers who truly care.

s3.f3: Practicals in the laboratory, quiet hours in the library, march-past on the field and trips out into the world. Every day at JECK is full.

l1.f2: Come and see JECK for yourself.
l1.f3: Visit on any school day between 8am and 5pm. Tour the classrooms, laboratory and library, and meet our teachers.
Admissions are open for JSS1 and other classes where space is available. Collect a form, sit the entrance exam and join us.
